brothel.name: Brothel
brothel.skill_description: Mystical concoctions and elixirs that enhance intimate experiences. Hag Potions help avoid pregnancy and sickness. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

restaurant.name: Restaurant
restaurant.skill_description: High-quality cooking components and rare spices that elevate culinary creations. Better ingredients help your chefs overcome complex recipes and impress discerning patrons with exceptional flavors. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

adventurers_guild.name: Adventurer's Guild
adventurers_guild.skill_description: Masterwork tools, weapons, and armor crafted with precision and care. Superior equipment enables your smiths to tackle demanding commissions and create legendary items that exceed customer expectations. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.skill_description: Luxurious furnishings, comfortable beds, and welcoming atmospheres that make guests feel at home. Enhanced accommodations help your innkeepers handle difficult guests and create memorable experiences. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

casino.name: Casino
casino.skill_description: Advanced defensive measures, trained guards, and protective enchantments that keep dangers at bay. Improved security helps your guardians overcome threatening situations and protect both workers and patrons. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

governor_castle.name: Castle
governor_castle.skill_description: Exquisite furnishings, rare wines, and opulent decorations that impress the aristocracy. Enhanced luxury helps your courtiers handle demanding nobles and create unforgettable experiences. Formula: Base Level + Skill Bonus = Success chance in Events.

academy.name: Academy
academy.skill_description: The Academy offers structured courses: Academics (Clever + random skill), Amatory Arts (sex skills), Hospitality Arts (Charm & Service), and Artisan Studies (Craft + random skill). Assign workers to a course to gain experience daily.

arena.name: Arena
arena.skill_description: The Arena hosts combat and spectacle: Exhibition bouts (controlled, wooden weapons), Proving bouts (veteran opponents), Championship fights (champions and beasts), and Pin up Barbarians (risqué spectacle). Assign workers to a role to earn money and reputation.
